I changed it to <PRIZE> so the markup follows one schema (one fix for the tag pair). 3) Semantic markup: The closing phrase 'und viele andere mehr, davon der Bericht bey Ihme zu vernemmen' ('and many others more, about which one can inquire from him') is not part of the last book entry. Rappen,</PRIZE>', which leaves this sentence as text belonging to <ITEM>. 4) Character encoding: The text contained mojibake, i.e. UTF-8 characters misread as Mac Roman.
